data.narrative:
SatRev is a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Grzegorz Zwolinski, Damian Fijałkowski, and Radosław Łapczyński. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 same-sector, same- and adjacent-stage private companies, alongside a broader reference universe of 5 public Space & Aerospace tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 additional private comparables.

The Peer-Median method is the primary applicable approach. The median valuation across 5 comparable private companies—Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B Series C), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—yields $1.5B. This range spans $1.1B to $8.0B, reflecting heterogeneity in stage advancement and company maturity. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied: the public Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 26.4x median P/S multiple, but SatRev's revenue is not on file, precluding a revenue-multiple calculation.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $1.3B (low) to $1.7B (high), centered at $1.5B median. Key uncertainties include SatRev's revenue profile and growth trajectory relative to the peer set, stage-specific valuation adjustments within Series B, and the wide dispersion in the comparable universe—particularly the $8.0B outlier at Series C—which limits precision for early-stage positioning.
